# @provenance rule: rule_class
class Payroll(Base):
    # @provenance rule: rule_method
    def pays(self):
        return True


# @provenance verification: examples
# @provenance rule: rule_decorated_async
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "hours", [39, 40]
)
async def test_pays(hours):
    assert hours > 38

    entries: list

    assert hours > 38

    return rest
